title: Lovely Sweet Chinese Pork Dumplings
description: Sweet and chewy Chinese dumplings filled with pork and pickles, perfect for a crowd, with a Mediterranean twist and Sichuan inspiration, featuring bhuna spices for added flavor

ingredients.name: ground pork
ingredients.notes: preferably with some fat for flavor

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine ground pork, pickle relish, bhuna spice mix, soy sauce, and sesame oil, and mix well with your hands or a wooden spoon until just combined
Lay a wonton wrapper on a flat surface and place a small spoonful of the pork mixture in the center of the wrapper
Dip your finger in a small amount of water and run it along the edges of the wrapper
Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point
Press the edges together to seal the dumpling
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling
In a large pot of boiling water, cook the dumplings for 10-12 minutes, or until they float to the surface
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon and serve hot with chopped scallions and a side of soy sauce for dipping
